What is a Virtual Machine?
A Virtual Machine is a computer that runs in the cloud. It works like a normal laptop or server, you install an operating system, apps, and tools, but Azure provides and maintains the physical hardware behind the scenes.

Virtual Machines are ideal when you need:
• Full control over the operating system
• The ability to run custom software
• Custom hosting or configuration setups

You can run:
• One Virtual Machine → great for testing, dev, small workloads
• Many Virtual Machines → high availability, bigger workloads, predictable scaling

When do Virtual Machines make sense?
• Testing & development
• Apps with variable demand
• Extending your datacenter
• Disaster recovery
• Lift‑and‑shift migrations

If you need control and reliability, Virtual Machines are the move.
